Slop Inventory · In development

Inventory and barcode scanning

Products, stock and barcode scanning. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Slop Inventory has these main features: Camera or any USB scanner, with undo; Stock by location, transfers and counts. It opens CSV.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with Slop Inventory

  • A free alternative to an inventory spreadsheet
  • Scan barcodes into your inventory
  • Do a stock count (stocktake)
  • Low stock alerts and reorder levels
  • A free Sortly alternative for stock tracking
